TaskDescription: Continuous 130 Hz monopolar DBS of the right lead at contact level 6 with the intensity increased in 0.5 mA steps from 0.5 mA up to 4.5 mA or the side-effect threshold (README; Wiest et al. 2022: blocks of ~47 s separated by ~28 s rest; in patient 2 also 100/130/150/180 Hz for 2 min each at one contact). LFPs from the adjacent levels recorded bipolar, all other contacts unipolar. Release file label 'DBS'.

DCRemoval.Description: Undocumented DC removal / high-pass before release: every released channel, including the head accelerometers, is free of DC offset (no gravity component; 10 s window means small compared with the channel SD; DC-check Jobs ieeg-b3w12-dyst-dc-1008124055 and ieeg-b3w12-dyst-dc2-1008124329), whereas the TMSi Saga is DC-coupled; the Spike2 files came from a 'processed_data/SMR' folder. Cutoff not stated by the source. The sampling rate (4096 Hz) is the acquisition rate (Wiest et al. 2022).

RecordingSoftware: custom software written in C (Wiest et al. 2022); exported to Spike2 .smr and then to MATLAB (SmrData)
iEEGReference: unipolar contacts and EEG: common mode rejection (README); contacts adjacent to the stimulated level: bipolar (labels like L13)
iEEGPlacementScheme: bilateral externalised octopolar DBS lead(s) spanning STN (inferior contacts), rostral zona incerta and ventrolateral thalamus (superior contacts); recorded 4-7 days after surgery off anti-dystonic medication (Wiest et al. 2022)
ElectricalStimulationParameters: monopolar 130 Hz DBS at right contact level 6, intensity ramp 0.5-4.5 mA in 0.5 mA steps (README; Wiest et al. 2022); timing and intensity in the Cur/Am channels
